correctness.rationale: The positive dyadic martingale is normalized by conditional cancellation. Its squared factors have frequencies \(0,\pm1,\pm2\), and character orthogonality imposes one divisibility constraint. The finite carry states \(\{-1,0,1\}\) reduce exactly to the two-state matrix B; exhaustive rational checks of the digit sums validate its indexing, including terminal carries. Trace and determinant give the stated distinct eigenvalues and exact moment recurrence. Cylinder coincidence probability is precisely \(2^{-N}S_N\), hence Tonelli reduces the energy integral to a nonnegative geometric series; this proves the iff threshold, rational energy formula, critical pole and finite-resolution leading coefficient. The script confirms finite cases but analytic reasoning establishes all parameters and levels; endpoint behavior is explicitly separated.

Its second-moment correlation exponent is a natural invariant measuring concentration of a probability measure and exactly determining which singular p-adic energies converge. The complete two-state resolution is structural, not a numerical table: it determines all finite-level collisions, the exact energy function, a continuously varying critical exponent, and a sharp critical residue. Qualitative Fourier or Hausdorff dimension statements do not imply these constants; the chosen family is mathematically canonical rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
